Contract A is unfulfilled wherever a request holder reaches a substitution only across the public API (a caller in another package, or dynamic dispatch into an exported method, Engine or any other interface); each such site is listed and counted as unfulfilled-contract-a against this tracked deferral, never as a pass. Each entry is logged and counted; an entry that matches nothing fails. publicPackages: packages whose exported API, like storage's, is the deferred public boundary (Nornic2, 31 October 2026: exported auth APIs). publicEntries: single exported functions that are the same deferred boundary (Nornic2, 31 October 2026: cypher.RedactLiterals).
